- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for eco-friendly all-purpose cleaning sprays and prefers natural products.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised the user to read labels and check ingredients when switching to eco-friendly products.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant emphasized considering packaging and the company's sustainability practices when choosing eco-friendly products.
- [PREFERENCE] User is considering making their own all-purpose cleaning spray using natural ingredients like baking soda and vinegar.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a basic all-purpose cleaning spray recipe, including:
  - 1 cup water
  - 1/2 cup white vinegar
  - 2 tablespoons castile soap
  - 1 teaspoon baking soda
  - 10 drops of essential oil (optional)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided instructions for the cleaning spray recipe and additional tips for DIY cleaning products.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant shared other DIY cleaning recipes, including:
  1. Glass Cleaner: 1 cup water, 1/2 cup white vinegar, 1 tablespoon cornstarch.
  2. Scouring Powder: 1 cup baking soda, 1/2 cup washing soda, 1 tablespoon castile soap.
  3. Carpet Deodorizer: 1 cup baking soda, 1/2 cup cornstarch, 10 drops of essential oil.
